_comment: M7-18 claim-channel A/B for the DEPLOYED thief (NOT the CI-gated arena): what reading the opponent cop's capture claims is worth to the vector we actually ship, under the counted physics. The two thief arms are the SAME brain with the SAME options - only the information feed differs, so the columns isolate the channel. thief-brain-bookv1 = hidden (the pre-M7-18 thief, reproducing the m7-16 baseline exactly); thief-brain-claim = truth (lag 0 - what the peer path actually delivers, since the cop claims the cell it is STANDING ON when we decide; the cop repo's m7-18 work found the M7-14 truth-lag1 model understated this). champion_pin null: this measures an information channel, it does not gate our champion.
